_doc: Settings hooks for change hypotheses (robot/overlay.py, robot/gen/changes.py). Values that map to ops are pure spec overlays; env hooks are build-time settings the robust runner applies as choice edits. Anchors are named locations a part can be added at. Owners map build files to the fixer that owns them.

top_deck_rear._why: standing on the Ti top panel (top z 20.4) behind the switch

rear_outside._why: behind the tub rear face (y -37.6), between the rear wheels

tub_interior_rear._why: inside the tub between the N10s on the rear axle line

weapon.type._why: weapon style (params_weapon.WEAPON_TYPES): drisk is built; any other value fails spec generation with the reason

weapon.motor._why: one catalog weapon motor id: stator, bell, shaft, RV03 stator screws, back spacer, spider screws and the outboard bearing follow from that entry (weapon_motor.describe); a weapon_motor swap is this setting

chassis.compartments._why: declared compartment layout (params_chassis.COMPARTMENTS): standard = motor pockets + stop wall/key tab/ledge and the pack bay cut from the catalog envelope; none = no compartment features; split_battery_bay = standard plus a rib between the pack bay and the electronics bay

size.width._why: overall width: a delta in mm ("4", "-3.5") or a percentage of the stock width (params_chassis.size_delta); both side walls move (CH_HALF_W). A shrink stops where the two gearmotors are a skin apart at the centre (CH_HALF_W_MIN)

size.length._why: overall length: mm or a percentage of the stock length; the nose moves (front wall CH_Y1, front wheel axle SA / SB, weapon axis WY, front column row, top-panel tab); the rear wall, drive axle and stop wall stay. A shrink stops where the pack meets the front wall (CH_Y1_MIN)

size.height._why: overall height: mm or a percentage of the stock height; the rim moves (CH_Z1: deck, top panel, mount notch top) and the weapon axis WZ with it. A shrink stops where the gearbox top meets the deck (CH_Z1_MIN)

drive.location._why: drive axle line (params_chassis.DRIVE_LOCATIONS -> RY): the tub's keyhole, key tab, stop wall, pad recess, motor pocket, the pack bay and the rig's n10/wheel_face joints follow it; side panels, forks, hubs and belts (owner C) and the rear-only tub structure do not yet

drive.motor._why: catalog id of the drive gearmotor (params_chassis.DRIVE_MOTOR); the tub pockets, MOTX, key tab, stop wall, pad and rig joints are derived from it

switch.power._why: catalog id of the power switch (params_chassis.SWITCH); the pad, pilots, screws (from its catalog mount holes, none: adhesive) and its pocket in the tub are derived from it

battery.pack._why: catalog id of the pack (params_hardware.BATTERY); the bay is cut from its envelope, it stands against the stop wall and the deck

drive.esc._why: catalog id of the receiver / drive ESC (params_chassis.RXESC); its bay is cut from the envelope

weapon.esc._why: catalog id of the weapon ESC (params_chassis.WESC); its bay is cut from the envelope

drive.belt._why: belt drive between the rear hub groove and the front hub groove: o_ring = the stock O-ring belts; none = no belt, for wheels without a belt groove (catalogue wheels have none: the O-ring has nothing to ride in). The front wheels then free-wheel (same overlay as 2WD, but a different cause: the wheel, not the drive layout)

wheel_od._doc: wheel position -> params literal of its outer diameter (axle height, nose and standoffs derive from it); a catalog wheel swap without a swap setting sets it to the new wheel's OD

_unsupported_why: exception classes for a layout the robot cannot build yet (a missing feature, scored not expressible); declared_unfit is for parts that genuinely do not fit (n/a). DriveLocationError moved here with A's agreement (coordinator, after #51).
